lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Posterior to the pectoral fin, the lateral flank exhibits high-luminance blobs arranged in approximately six semi-parallel horizontal rows. These blobs are distributed with relatively uniform spacing, creating a predictable 2D grid of local maxima across the mid-body.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a series of nodes where the high-luminance spots align with the vertical structures.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient where the dorsal edge of each ridge is highlighted and the ventral edge is in shadow.
